name: Suspicious Celestial Tea Crisp
desc: A novel take on Wangxiao Cakes. Try breaking off a piece of this, and it snaps apart like a weathered brick. It's so bitter, you'd think someone had simply thrown some tea leaves directly into the mixing bowl and then called it a day... This is definitely not something you'd want to bring to Xiangling or Escoffier for any reason.

value.text: Increases all party members' ATK by 224 and CRIT Rate by 6% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
